what can you do with it

I can help you navigate and interact with this browser in many ways, such as:

- Scrolling up, down, left, right, or to the top or bottom of the page
- Opening, closing, or switching between tabs
- Updating a tab's URL to navigate to a new page
- Zooming in, out, or resetting the zoom level
- Clicking buttons or links identified by action IDs
- Typing text into input fields and submitting them
- Managing chats (creating, loading, renaming, deleting, searching)
- Controlling the chat HUD and sidebar visibility
- Adjusting settings for language models if integrated

Just tell me what you'd like to do, and I can perform the action for you.
